description:
Read a site's latest Site Audit crawl (or run_id): Site Health 0–100, theme scores, failing checks, what wasn't checked, problem pages and the last 5 runs.

Billing: free — reads the stored run; nothing is fetched.

When to call: after crawl_site returns "running", or to read an earlier crawl. One check's URLs: get_crawl_issue; what changed between two crawls: compare_crawls (both free).

Staleness: stale: true (over 30 days old, or before the 2026-09-24 crawler fixes): don't verify fixes against it. coverage "legacy": before Site Audit checks (issue rollup only); "partial": stopped early, Site Health covers the pages crawled. cwv_state "pending": read again in minutes. Never report not_run checks as passed.

Returns: { site_id, run: { run_id, status, completed_at, pages_crawled, billed_cents, settings, … }, stale, coverage, stage, site_health, counts, themes: { <id>: { score, failing, ran } }, cwv_state, checks: [{ id, severity, title, n, of }] (≤40, worst first), not_run: [{ id, reason }], vs_previous? (incomplete_baseline: a capped earlier crawl inflates new), history, schedule, theme?, check?, issues_summary, pages_view, pages_total, next_offset, pages, suggested_next?, next_step, note? }. provisional: true while crawling. { run: null }: never crawled.

check.description: A check id from checks[].id: lists the pages failing it, with its rule, why and fix.

checks.description: With theme: 'failing' (default) or 'all' (adds the theme's passed checks).

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

limit.description: Pages per call. Default 10 (fewer when long URLs would push the answer past 12 KB; next_offset continues), legacy runs 25; max 100.

offset.description: Default 0. Use next_offset from the previous answer.

pages.description: 'issues' (default; 'none' with a full theme report): pages failing an error or warning check, worst first, as { url, http_status, depth, checks, inlinks, ilr }; 'all'; or 'none'.

run_id.description: Optional run id (history[].run_id). Default: the latest run.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

theme.description: Adds this theme's report: score, checks with why and fix, and details (status, depth and load-time buckets, robots, sitemaps, TLS, hreflang, per-page CWV, AI bot access).

name: get_latest_crawl
title: Fetch a site's latest crawl: Site Health, theme scores and failing checks
